item.jaymospowers.chain_axe.whirl: Hold right-click to whirl the axe head on its chain; let go to bring it down where you look
item.jaymospowers.chain_axe.buried: It stays buried in what it hits: right-click beside them to work it free, or from afar to rip it out
jei.jaymospowers.chain_axe: An axe head on a length of chain. Hold right click to whirl it round you, and let go to bring it down where you look. The head stays buried in whoever it hits and the haft is useless until it is out: right click beside them to work it free, or from further off to rip it out by the chain for a second wound. Forged at the Tool Station from a Chain Axe Head, a Tool Handle and an iron chain.
